title: 供应商多指标综合评价
context: 采购部门需要可解释的供应商评分。
requirements: 2025年到期采购行；至少10行；准时足量率40%、完整率25%、质量合格率20%、合同价格达标率15%（实际采购价≤合同价行数/到期行数）；质量分母为0时评分NULL；输出各指标和总分，按总分降序。
commonError: 不说明权重、样本门槛和缺失指标处理会使评分不可解释。
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT v.supplier_id,COUNT(*) n,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN v.on_time>=v.quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) ot,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN v.accepted>=v.quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) fill,100.0*SUM(accepted)/NULLIF(SUM(received),0) quality,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN v.unit_price_cents<=c.unit_price_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) price_ok FROM v_po_lines v JOIN purchase_order_items i ON i.po_item_id=v.po_item_id JOIN supplier_contracts c ON c.contract_id=i.contract_id WHERE v.promised_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY v.supplier_id) SELECT supplier_id,n due_lines,ROUND(ot,2) ontime_pct,ROUND(fill,2) complete_pct,ROUND(quality,2) quality_pct,ROUND(price_ok,2) contract_pct,ROUND(.4*ot+.25*fill+.2*quality+.15*price_ok,2) score FROM a WHERE n>=10 ORDER BY score DESC,supplier_id
